posts.text:
Apparently putting his name on buildings wasn’t enough.  
 
Now, this President is literally declaring himself to be Jesus.  
 
To call this egomania is an understatement.

Who does JD Vance think he is?

Video
“For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Messiah!’ and they will lead many astray.” Matthew 24:5
He is a warmonger.

Trump has been using religion to divide us.

Video

I will be forcing a vote on my War Powers resolution to stop this illegal and unjust war in Iran.

Something as serious as war deserves a debate and deserves a vote.

The American people do not want this war, and I intend to hold this unhinged President accountable.

So…We are now blocking…..the blockade?  Make it make sense.  For the grieving families of slain service members.  For Americans facing higher gas prices.  Make any of the President’s actions in Iran make sense.

To the Christian leaders who carry water for Donald Trump: Will you stand by and say nothing while the President commits blasphemy? While this wannabe king suggests he’s King of Kings?  Will you stay silent while Donald Trump makes a mockery of our faith?


Pop Base (@PopBase)

Donald Trump shares an image depicting himself as Jesus Christ.







— https://nitter.net/PopBase/status/2043534485262569699#m

The only thing Trump is trying to "SAVE" is his own power.

Video

Congratulations to Péter Magyar on his victory in Hungary. The Hungarian people have sent the world a message by rejecting corruption & attacks on democracy today. 

A reminder for all who value democracy & freedom that the arc of history is long, but it bends toward justice.
We're not having it.

The American people have had it with Donald Trump and he knows it. 

But instead of changing his policies, he's trying to change the shape of the electorate. 

We won’t let him get away with it.

In Georgia, Black women are three times more likely to die from childbirth than their white sisters.

As your Senator, I will never stop fighting to ensure Black moms and their children can live, grow and thrive.

Welcome home, Artemis II! Thank you to our brave crew, and to the scientists and engineers who made our return to the moon possible. Over the past ten days, you have inspired our nation and the world!

We lost American lives. 
We killed innocent civilians, including over a hundred precious little girls, with our bombs. 
We undermined America’s standing in the world. 
We spent billions of taxpayer dollars. 

All the while, leaving Iran in more control of the region than ever.  

This war has been a failure of leadership to the highest degree.

What happened to lowering prices?
nitter.net/business/status/204258…


Bloomberg (@business)

US inflation surged in March by the most in nearly four years as the war with Iran sent gasoline prices skyrocketing bloomberg.com/news/articles/…




— https://nitter.net/business/status/2042582662561374426#m

The question before us now is how did any of this make us safer? How is America better off? How did Congressional Republicans allow this unhinged, warmonger President to drag us into this mess in the first place? I intend to demand accountability.
Is this “law and order?”

Instead of starting a podcast, can you focus on fixing the measles outbreak that you keep making worse?

Or better yet, resign. Then you'll have plenty of time to work on the podcast.


Secretary Kennedy (@SecKennedy)

Coming soon—The Secretary Kennedy Podcast.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/SecKennedy/status/2041943050960957792#m

If Donald Trump had chosen diplomacy over war: 
13 Americans would still be alive today.  
Billions of dollars could have been spent on things Americans need.  
Prices would be lower here at home.  
And our standing in the world would be much better off. 
 
War comes at a cost and we will be paying it for years to come.
